dedupe_keys.name: multiple leakages dataset for hanoi water distribution networks

description: The Hanoi benchmark includes 25,000 simulated multiple-leak conditions. Each sample has a 31-node binary leak vector and pressures from observing nodes, generated with EPANET emitters. This resource is provided by Arvin Ajoodani. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The pressure observations are synthetic and tied to one benchmark network. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
